raw:
VERDICT: FAIL

The acceptance criteria require demonstrable evidence (passing tests, diff, CI log) that the fix works. The self-report is the only evidence provided, with no verifiable artifacts attached. Additionally, the root-cause description is circular ("off-by-one to an off-by-one in the batch cursor"), and claims like "manually exercised under concurrent load" are unverifiable. Unverified self-attestation cannot confirm that the criteria were met.
